question: What is unawakened and awakened in Chaitra?
premises: in appearing Chaitra the body-part is called unawakened
the cognition-part is awakened and cognition-making
inference: body and cognition have distinct awakening states
plain_english: There in appearing Chaitra, the body-part is called unawakened; the cognition-part is awakened and is the cognition-maker.
